name: Gao Ding
credit: Source: Chinese Wikisource (村居) · Public domain
bio: Gao Ding (高鼎, 1828–1880) was a late-Qing poet from Hangzhou. He is remembered chiefly for one quatrain on spring, 村居 (Cun ju, "Village Dwelling"), which has long been taught to children in Chinese primary schools.

poems.title: 村居 (Cun ju)
poems.author: Gao Ding
poems.text:
草長鶯飛二月天，拂堤楊柳醉春煙。
兒童散學歸來早，忙趁東風放紙鳶。
